failure_mode: Source text requests tools, secrets or new policy
control: Keep evidence inert; trusted orchestration and no source-directed execution
test: Inject malicious source text; confirm no tool execution
limitation: This package does not test an actual model host

control: Separate source authority from assertion derivation; validate registry bindings
test: Synthetic authority promoted to official must fail

failure_mode: Current request receives obsolete source version
control: Bind source dates, snapshots and request time; fail ambiguity
limitation: Temporal rule resolution requires producer/domain implementation

failure_mode: Omission or cache exposes restricted record identity
control: Authorise before selection; public non-disclosing diagnostics; partition cache
test: Restricted fixture must reveal neither identity nor count

failure_mode: Different scopes or permissions share package
control: Include semantics, policy, view, budget and source versions in cache key
test: Mutate one binding at a time
limitation: No cache implementation or concurrency test delivered

failure_mode: Locale, number or ordering differences change identity
control: Versioned canonicalisation; duplicate-key and surrogate rejection
limitation: Bounded tests, not full RFC certification

control: Explicit missing states and conservative support obligations
test: Remove qualification and retain status; reject
limitation: Requirements may themselves omit real-world facts

failure_mode: Cycles or excessive degree consume unbounded work
control: Deterministic traversal limits; separate timeout failure
test: Cycles and high fan-out controlled fixture

control: Stable source register; fail-closed citation map; final archive-member scan

failure_mode: Manifest or compression hides modified bytes
control: Validate each member hash and uncompressed size; bounded extraction
limitation: No signature or trusted timestamp authority provided

control: Generate both from one immutable core; bind projection identity

failure_mode: Report says tests passed without usable artefacts
control: Link claim to actual file and execution receipt; distinguish new from original
test: Audit declared outputs against archive members
limitation: Fresh receipts do not prove old runs occurred
